issues: Fix canvas tinting in Sprites.draw: using globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop' directly on the main rendering context tints background pixels already rendered on the canvas. Perform tinting on an offscreen canvas or temp buffer before compositing onto ctx.
Fix memory leak in loadImageFile: call URL.revokeObjectURL(src) inside Image.onload and Image.onerror when falling back to HTMLImageElement creation.
Normalize asset loading paths in loadSprites to cleanly handle root-relative web paths (e.g., '/assets/sprites/...') as public/ is usually stripped by web servers/bundlers at runtime.
